serialization.notes: All seven adapted student payload variants parsed and reserialized byte-identically. Payloads charge the shared base, task IDs, each Mirror angle or control/private state, tensor names, shapes, dtype, dimensions and headers; resume bytes separately serialize optimizer state.

metric_replay.notes: Exploratory replay matched all quality, actual-byte, training-example/update and active-compute fields exactly. Wall-clock and inference throughput are timing measurements and were excluded.

notes: Development gate failed in both aligned seeds because Mirror teacher KL exceeded 1.10x ordinary multi-head KL, despite meeting the absolute 1e-4 KL, top-1, ECE and <=0.50x byte subgates.
The three registered fresh seeds were mistakenly run after the development relative-KL subgate was overlooked. They are retained as exploratory rows and excluded from the status decision.
Exploratory fresh rerun was exact on metrics/bytes/compute; timing was not expected to replay.
Aligned teachers were deliberately constructed from the candidate Givens hidden-view transformation; no broad expert-distillation or language-model claim.
